text:
maria (growth): Quick sync — planning a 30m micro-workshop next Wed for new PLG cohort. Goal: seed 5 credits + a starter prompt pack, then measure activation lift. Thoughts?
sam (product): love it. main ask: keep the demo focused on 1 clear 'first-success' flow. show a prompt template -> generated output -> embed step.
devin (content): I can draft 3 prompt packs: 'Sales helper', 'Docs summarizer', 'Code assistant'. We should A/B the hero prompt.
noah (ops): Landing page + signup funnel: we can add an auto-apply credit hook on signup. Need the promo code ID and expiry. Also can route inbound leads to dedicated onboarding flow via query param.
gita (analytics): Metrics we should track: activation rate (first API call or AI-generated doc), time-to-first-success, tokens consumed in 7d, cost-per-activated-user. Also capture utm_campaign + variant.
maria (growth): Variant plan: Variant A = 5 credits + 'Sales helper' by default. Variant B = 10 credits + 'Docs summarizer' + onboarding email. Hypothesis: bigger credits shorten time-to-success but may increase spend. Track cost delta.
sam (product): Can we gate Variant B to only new signups from webinar RSVP? want to limit spend.
noah (ops): Yep — implement via signup param ?seed=webinar_b. Also will set server-side cap per-customer. pseudocode:```python
if params.get('seed') == 'webinar_b' and user.is_new():
    apply_credits(user, 1000)
```
gita (analytics): Add event names: "credit_applied", "prompt_pack_installed", "first_success_generated". We'll hook to experiment id.
devin (content): Webinar script snippet (30s): "We'll show how to go from idea to a polished one-pager in under 3 prompts using the starter pack." Short demo + 2 min self-serve time.
maria (growth): Social / launch posts: 1) teaser w/ demo gif 2) sign-up CTA 3) post-webinar snapshot + prompt pack link. Drafts by EOD?
devin (content): I'll push drafts to the campaign doc and share in #marketing-drafts.
noah (ops): Ops checklist: create coupon code, set routing param, prepare webhook for 'credit_applied' -> onboarding mailer. I'll tag deploy-bot once infra is ready.
ops-bot: calendar event created: "Micro-workshop: Starter Prompt Cohort" Wed 11:00-11:30
 gita (analytics): Can we run a small holdout (10%) with no credits to measure baseline?
maria (growth): yes let's do 10% holdout. make it random but stratified by traffic source.
sam (product): Final ask: capture qualitative snippets — 1-sentence user outcome post-demo (via short survey). We'll use for benchmark narrative.
devin (content): I'll add the 1-question survey: "Did you get a usable output in 3 attempts?" with single-click options.
gita (analytics): I'll set up dashboard: cohort by variant, activation %, median time-to-success, and 7d token cost. Link when ready.
maria (growth): Great. Action items: @devin content drafts by EOD, @noah ops hooks + coupon by Tue, @gita dashboard ready Wed AM, @sam confirm demo flow. We'll reconvene Tue 10am. :thumbsup:
